correctness.rationale: Two-equation symmetry reduction is exact: unpinned side potentials U,V depend only on counts (q,r), with determinant 1-lambda^2(1-s)(1-t)>0. The feasibility polynomial counts all labelled pinned choices by binomial weights; saturated parts have opposite-side hit potential lambda. In s>=t half-plane, u>=tau forces s>=f(t) with f strictly decreasing and concave for tau<lambda, so the linear cost is bounded below by the smaller endpoint costs a min(1,rho) and (a+b)beta; reverse half-plane is no better since a<=b. One-sided rounding attains ceil L; balanced rounding attains <=ceil L+1; tau=lambda and >lambda boundaries follow from one-step cap. Independent exact occupancy enumeration for K_{3,4}, lambda=1/3,tau=1/8 gives L=2, optimum=3 and 31 optimal sets in (1,2),(2,1),(3,0) profiles 18,12,1. Comparison rho/beta=(1+lambda)/lambda gives the claimed aspect-ratio threshold. The result is internally correct, including sharp +1 witness.
